section.title: Inspection scope
section.para: Inspect the forward fuselage structure for visible damage, condition degradation, loose/missing hardware, seal breakdown, and evidence of interface distress across the named section branches.

Baseline inspection zones: radome/nose structure, forward pressure bulkhead, flight deck structure, side-window surrounds, NLG bay and attach, forward equipment bay, forward barrel, and forward door/hatch surrounds.

section.title: Radome-specific checks available from current SSOT
section.para: Inspect the radome for erosion, impact damage, moisture-ingress indicators, hinge/latch condition, and degradation of bonding/diverter mounting provisions.
Treat weather-radar and lightning-diverter hardware as referenced system items; verify only the section-owned interfaces and provisions in this data module.
